# sjPlot - Data Visualization for Statistics in Social Science

[![CRAN_Status_Badge](http://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/sjPlot)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=sjPlot)

Collection of plotting and table output functions for data
visualization. Results of various statistical analyses (that are
commonly used in social sciences) can be visualized using this package,
including simple and cross tabulated frequencies, histograms, box plots,
(generalized) linear models, mixed effects models, PCA and correlation
matrices, cluster analyses, scatter plots, Likert scales, effects plots
of interaction terms in regression models, constructing index or score
variables and much more.

## Installation

### Latest development build

To install the latest development snapshot (see latest changes below),
type the following commands into the R console:

``` r

library(devtools)
devtools::install_github("strengejacke/sjPlot")
```

### Official, stable release

To install the latest stable release from CRAN, type the following
command into the R console:

``` r

install.packages("sjPlot")
```

## Documentation and examples

Please visit <https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/> for documentation
and vignettes.

## Citation

In case you want / have to cite my package, please use
`citation('sjPlot')` for citation information. Since core functionality
of package depends on the
[ggplot-package](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ggplot2), consider
citing this package as well.

[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.1308157.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1308157)

# Package index

## Package Description

- [`sjPlot-package`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-package.md)
  [`sjPlot`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-package.md)
  : Data Visualization for Statistics in Social Science

## Plotting Regression Models

- [`plot_model()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_model.md)
  [`get_model_data()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_model.md)
  : Plot regression models
- [`plot_models()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_models.md)
  : Forest plot of multiple regression models

## Regression Model Tables

- [`tab_model()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_model.md)
  : Print regression models as HTML table

## Plotting Regression Model Diagnostics

- [`plot_model()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_model.md)
  [`get_model_data()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_model.md)
  : Plot regression models
- [`plot_residuals()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_residuals.md)
  : Plot predicted values and their residuals
- [`sjp.poly()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjp.poly.md)
  : Plot polynomials for (generalized) linear regression

## Plotting Descriptive Statistics

- [`plot_frq()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_frq.md)
  : Plot frequencies of variables
- [`plot_gpt()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_gpt.md)
  : Plot grouped proportional tables
- [`plot_likert()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_likert.md)
  : Plot likert scales as centered stacked bars
- [`plot_scatter()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_scatter.md)
  : Plot (grouped) scatter plots
- [`plot_stackfrq()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_stackfrq.md)
  : Plot stacked proportional bars
- [`plot_grpfrq()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_grpfrq.md)
  : Plot grouped or stacked frequencies
- [`plot_xtab()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_xtab.md)
  : Plot contingency tables
- [`sjp.chi2()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjp.chi2.md)
  : Plot Pearson's Chi2-Test of multiple contingency tables
- [`sjplot()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjplot.md)
  [`sjtab()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjplot.md)
  : Wrapper to create plots and tables within a pipe-workflow

## Descriptive Statistics Tables

- [`tab_stackfrq()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_stackfrq.md)
  : Summary of stacked frequencies as HTML table
- [`tab_xtab()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_xtab.md)
  [`sjt.xtab()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_xtab.md)
  : Summary of contingency tables as HTML table
- [`tab_corr()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_corr.md)
  : Summary of correlations as HTML table

## Generate Tables from Data Frames, Codebooks

- [`tab_df()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_df.md)
  [`tab_dfs()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_df.md)
  : Print data frames as HTML table.
- [`view_df()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/view_df.md)
  : View structure of labelled data frames

## Variable/Feature Reduction

- [`tab_fa()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_fa.md)
  : Summary of factor analysis as HTML table
- [`tab_pca()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_pca.md)
  : Summary of principal component analysis as HTML table
- [`tab_itemscale()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_itemscale.md)
  [`sjt.itemanalysis()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/tab_itemscale.md)
  : Summary of item analysis of an item scale as HTML table

## Plot Customization

- [`set_theme()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/set_theme.md)
  : Set global theme options for sjp-functions
- [`theme_sjplot()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`theme_sjplot2()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`theme_blank()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`theme_538()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`font_size()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`label_angle()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`legend_style()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`scale_color_sjplot()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`scale_fill_sjplot()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`sjplot_pal()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`show_sjplot_pals()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  [`css_theme()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/sjPlot-themes.md)
  : Modify plot appearance

## Plot Distributions

- [`dist_chisq()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/dist_chisq.md)
  : Plot chi-squared distributions
- [`dist_f()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/dist_f.md)
  : Plot F distributions
- [`dist_norm()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/dist_norm.md)
  : Plot normal distributions
- [`dist_t()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/dist_t.md)
  : Plot t-distributions

## Utility Functions

- [`plot_grid()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/plot_grid.md)
  : Arrange list of plots as grid
- [`save_plot()`](https://strengejacke.github.io/sjPlot/reference/save_plot.md)
  : Save ggplot-figure for print publication

  Sample dataset from the EUROFAMCARE project

  : Save ggplot-figure for print publication
